`final class EdgeSmoothing`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.render.tessellator` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [EdgeSmoothing.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/render/tessellator/EdgeSmoothing.java)

Draws convex shapes with a soft edge one screen pixel wide, so that a rotated or scaled shape stays smooth without multisampling.

## Description

[`DrawShape`](/reference/drawing/drawshape/) and [`DrawResource`](/reference/drawing/drawresource/) use it under a rotation or a fractional scale; you call it only to smooth geometry of your own.
Coordinates are in screen pixels of the current matrices: the edge fades over half a pixel inside and half a pixel outside the outline.

- [Pixel alignment](/use/in-depth/pixel-alignment/)

| `void` | [polygon](#EdgeSmoothing-method-polygon)(float red, float green, float blue, float alpha, Point... points) <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span> | Draws the convex polygon through `points` in the color `red`, `green`, `blue`, `alpha` on 1, with a soft edge; a polygon thinner than one pixel draws with its coverage as opacity. |
| `void` | [rect](#EdgeSmoothing-method-rect)(double left, double top, double right, double bottom, double[] uv, float red, float green, float blue, float alpha) <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span> | Draws the rectangle from `left`, `top` to `right`, `bottom` with a soft edge, textured by the bound texture between the coordinates `uv` (`u0`, `v0`, `u1`, `v1`), and tinted by the color on 1. |

## Method details

<a id="EdgeSmoothing-method-isConvex"></a>

### isConvex

`boolean isConvex(Point... points)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

If `true`, the points, in order, form a convex polygon of 3 points or more; aligned points are allowed.

<a id="EdgeSmoothing-method-polygon"></a>

### polygon

`void polygon(float red, float green, float blue, float alpha, Point... points)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Draws the convex polygon through `points` in the color `red`, `green`, `blue`, `alpha` on 1, with a soft edge; a polygon thinner than one pixel draws with its coverage as opacity.

<a id="EdgeSmoothing-method-rect"></a>

### rect

`void rect(double left, double top, double right, double bottom, double[] uv, float red, float green, float blue, float alpha)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Draws the rectangle from `left`, `top` to `right`, `bottom` with a soft edge, textured by the bound texture between the coordinates `uv` (`u0`, `v0`, `u1`, `v1`), and tinted by the color on 1.
